title: CVE-2026-112555
summary: Affected: Apple macOS A validation issue was addressed with improved input sanitization. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. A malicious app may be able to break out of its sandbox.

title: CVE-2026-17225 — Multiple Vulnerabilities in IBM API Connect
summary: Affected: IBM API Connect IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions and access unauthorized analytics queries due to improper input validation. Request parameters are not validated sufficiently, which could allow restrictions on analytics data to be circumvented.

title: CVE-2026-17230 — Multiple Vulnerabilities in IBM API Connect
summary: Affected: IBM API Connect IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to a path traversal vulnerability.

title: CVE-2026-17231 — Multiple Vulnerabilities in IBM API Connect
summary: Affected: IBM API Connect IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to an observable response discrepancy.

title: CVE-2026-58969
summary: Affected: Google Android In multiple functions of MediaQualityService.java, there is a possible permission bypass due to a missing permission check. This could lead to local information disclosure with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

title: CVE-2026-58984
summary: Affected: Google Android In multiple locations, there is a possible memory corruption due to a use-after-free. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

title: CVE-2026-97195 — Secure Custom Fields < 6.9.8 - Admin+ Stored XSS via HTML Attribute Name Injection into Field Definition
summary: Affected: Unknown Secure Custom Fields The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not sanitize a persisted field definition before emitting part of it as an HTML attribute name, allowing a user able to configure its fields to store a payload that executes as JavaScript in the browser of any user who views a page rendering the affected field, which on multisite lets a site administrator who lacks the unfiltered_html capability inject script into other users' sessions.

title: CVE-2026-97194 — Secure Custom Fields < 6.9.8 - Contributor+ Unpublished Post Title and Status Disclosure via Relational Fields
summary: Affected: Unknown Secure Custom Fields The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not perform a read-permission check when it renders and formats the values of its relational fields, allowing users with post-editing access (Contributor and above) to disclose the titles and non-public statuses of other users' unpublished posts.

title: CVE-2026-97193 — Secure Custom Fields < 6.9.8 - Contributor+ Relationship Field Update on Arbitrary Objects via IDOR
summary: Affected: Unknown Secure Custom Fields The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not verify that a user is allowed to edit the target object before writing to it during bidirectional relationship synchronization, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to add or remove a reference to their own object on arbitrary posts, users, or terms they cannot otherwise edit.

title: CVE-2026-97192 — Secure Custom Fields < 6.9.8 - Contributor+ Admin-Restricted Custom Field Update via Post Save Path
summary: Affected: Unknown Secure Custom Fields The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not re-apply its field-group location rules when persisting values submitted through the post editor save path, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to write custom fields the site restricted to administrators onto their own posts.
